title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Installation and Wall-Mount Capabilities by Service Level
content:
Northgate Delivery & Installation crews install appliances and mount televisions only at the levels built for that work. For each service level, the schedule below states whether basic installation labor is included, which appliance installations the crew performs, whether the appliance being replaced is disconnected, the fee per appliance for the installation parts kit (hoses, cords, vent, water line), the fee for mounting one television on the wall, the largest screen mounted and the wall constructions mounted on.

## Appliance installation

| Service level | Basic installation labor included | Appliance installations performed | Appliance being replaced disconnected | Installation parts kit fee, per appliance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | No | None | No | $0.00 |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | No | None | No | $0.00 |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | No | None | No | $0.00 |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | No | None | No | $0.00 |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | Yes | Washer; electric dryer; electric range; dishwasher replacement; refrigerator with water line; over-the-range microwave replacement | Yes | $39.99 |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | No | None | No | $0.00 |

## Television wall mounting

| Service level | Wall-mount labor, per television | Largest screen mounted | Wall constructions mounted on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | $0.00 | 0 inches (no wall mounting) | None |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | $0.00 | 0 inches (no wall mounting) | None |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | $0.00 | 0 inches (no wall mounting) | None |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | $0.00 | 0 inches (no wall mounting) | None |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | $0.00 | 0 inches (no wall mounting) | None |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | $199.00 | 85 inches | Drywall over wood studs |

A largest screen of 0 inches means the level does no wall mounting.

## Reading the capability sheet

- Appliance installation, the installation parts kit and disconnection of the old appliance belong only to Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation.
- Wall mounting belongs only to Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation, for screens up to 85 inches on drywall over wood studs.
- **Hypothetical screens.** An 85-inch screen is within the largest size mounted; an 86-inch screen is larger than it.
